name: Andrea Trinchieri
bio: Andrea Trinchieri was born on August 6, 1968, in Milan. He began his coaching career at the age of 20 as a member of the coaching staff of Olimpia Milano, where he worked for six years (1998–2004).

name: Massimiliano Menetti
bio: Massimiliano “Max” Menetti was born on January, 1973, in Palmanova, Italy, and is widely regarded as one of the most accomplished coaches in modern Italian basketball. He also worked alongside Andrea Trinchieri during their time together at Zalgiris Kaunas.

name: Giorgos Dedas
bio: Giorgos Dedas was born on January 2, 1980, in Komotini, Greece. Known primarily for his ability as a three-point shooter, he played professionally for more than 15 years in Greece (MENT, Iraklis, Rethymno) and abroad (Breogán Lugo, Beirasar Rosalía, Cáceres 2016).

name: Charalampos Karaiskos
bio: Charalampos (Babis) Karaiskos was born on February 10, 1992, and began his playing career with Keravnos Larissa. He moved to Thessaloniki in 2005, where he continued with the Mandoulides Schools team, while also representing Greece at the youth and junior national team levels.

name: Andrew Antelidze
bio: Andrew Antelidze was born in New York City on August 15, 2000. His uncle, Levan Patsatsia, a former Georgian international basketball player, was the main reason he became involved in basketball.

name: Evangelos Margaritis
bio: Vangelis Margaritis was born in Katerini on December 5, 1982. He began playing basketball with Korinos Pierias (1997–99).

name: Stavros Chatzipetrou
bio: Stavros Chatzipetrou was born in Thessaloniki on June 15, 2004. He began his involvement in basketball in 2013 at the Hellenic Basketball Academy GBA as a player, progressing through all youth levels and competing in all age-group teams until 2022.
